A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same SlotSPE study and provide readable text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–I. V2's shorter pagination reflects layout reflow; no scientific material is missing.

before.justification: V1 reports original survival-prediction experiments across ten TCGA cohorts, including baseline comparisons, missing-genomics tests, ablations, efficiency measurements, and clinical and interpretability analyses.

after.justification: V2 retains these original experimental results in Tables 1–10 and Figures 3–14, including the supplementary analyses in Appendices D–I.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Appendix B retain the same slot attention, selective activation, reconstruction objectives, iterative cross-modal fusion, and missing-genomics inference procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same ten TCGA cohorts for disease-specific survival, with the same unimodal, multimodal, missing-genomics, clinical, and interpretability coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in corresponding experiments, including the unimodal and multimodal baselines in Tables 1 and 4–5, MOTCAT/CMTA/LD-CVAE comparisons in Table 6, and encoder and clinical comparisons in Tables 9–10.

E3.justification: Appendix C retains five-fold cross-validation, four survival intervals, 4096 sampled training patches per WSI, all-patch inference, and 30 training epochs with batch size 32. The separate ablation, efficiency, and clinical evaluation protocols also match.

E4.justification: The same component, encoder, slot-number, iteration, top-K, and temperature ablations remain. Missing-genomics robustness, efficiency breakdowns, clinical-utility analyses, and patient/cohort interpretability studies are also unchanged.

E5.justification: Both report standard deviations across five folds, log-rank tests, and RMST confidence intervals using 1000 bootstrap replicates (Appendix C and Table 7). Error-bar practices and statistical procedures are unchanged.

E6.justification: Matched numerical results and plotted findings are unchanged throughout. For example, SlotSPE's overall C-index remains 0.721 with both modalities and 0.704 with missing genomics (Tables 1–2); all appendix results are retained.

T1.justification: Equations 1–19 retain the same survival formulation, selection and reconstruction definitions, losses, and fusion updates. The computational-complexity reasoning in Section 3 is unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions concerning patient-specific prognostic events, biological alignment, efficiency, robustness, and interpretability. The claims of outperforming existing methods in eight cohorts and a 2.9% overall improvement are unchanged.

C2.justification: Mechanistic interpretations of slot specialization, cross-modal alignment, and missing-genomics robustness remain unchanged. Qualifications concerning slot saturation, reconstruction costs, and further biological validation are also retained.

D1.justification: V2 adds a code-availability statement and a SlotSPE GitHub repository link to the abstract; v1 supplies no code location. Implementation settings, hardware descriptions, and data-access information otherwise remain unchanged. The PDFs do not establish the linked repository's contents.

R1.justification: The cited works, bibliography, and related-work discussion are unchanged, including positioning patient-specific slots against PIBD/MMP prototypes and connecting the approach to factorial coding and slot attention.

P1.justification: V2 adds equal-contribution notes for Yilan Zhang and Li Nanbo, identifies Xin Gao as corresponding author, adjusts author punctuation, and adds the code-availability sentence. Scientific prose and section organization otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Abstract typography, local spacing, and page breaks change; the conclusion now fits on page 10 and references reflow. All 14 figures and 10 tables retain their content and design. Appendix pages are visually identical apart from page numbers.

improvement.justification: The new code-location statement improves reproducibility documentation, and the author-role notes clarify attribution. Methods, results, and appendix evidence remain unchanged, so the benefit is limited. This assessment concerns the added access information, not verification of the linked code.
